name: @byline/data-presentations
description: Byline Data's presentation SDK: defineDataTemplate (reusable, chosen in the newsroom) and defineDataPresentation (one project's repository-coded experience), the registry and its plain descriptors, the deterministic prepare step and the shared DataProjectView host. The built-in templates use exactly the same contract. Depends on React and @byline/data only: never Payload, Next or Astro, and no bundler-specific imports (each host loads styles.css and client.ts itself).
